description: Get one of the day's two GATE Daily subject sets for the user to solve: five original GATE CS questions on one subject, a deeper rep than the mixed daily set. For signed-in users (free); without a GATE Daily sign-in this asks the user to connect their account. Leave out subject to see the day's choice. Returns the questions without answers; submit the user's answers with submit_answers and the subject.

date.description: A past day's date, YYYY-MM-DD (IST). Leave out for the newest.

subject.description: Subject code of the set; leave out to list the day's sets.

name: get_subject_set

choices.description: without a subject, on a day with more than one set: the day's sets to choose from (and no questions)

text.description: the question in markdown (LaTeX between $ signs), without its answer

timeSec.description: about how long the question should take, in seconds

subject.description: subject code of a subject set; null for the daily set

today.description: the set's date is today in IST

title: Get a subject set
